headline: Customer Experience Specialist
summary: Customer experience specialist with four years in contact centre operations for telecom and e-commerce clients. I analyse call, email and survey data to find what frustrates customers, redesign the processes behind it, and coach agents on handling escalations. I have raised satisfaction scores on every account I have worked on.

experience.title: Customer Experience Specialist
bullets: Analyse call and email contact reasons, handling times and survey comments for an e-commerce account of 250 agents.
Redesigned the refund request journey, cutting repeat contacts by 27%.
Run the complaint escalation desk and coach team leads on difficult cases.
Rebuilt the Zendesk macros and help articles so agents give consistent answers.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Handled billing and service calls and emails for postpaid subscribers.
Kept customer records updated in the CRM after each contact.
